verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's Realtime API is documented as delivering live run updates and streaming data from background tasks to a frontend with no polling, including forwarding AI-provider token streams to users (docs-11, docs-30). This is backed by durable AI chat and realtime-frontend skills (docs-13, docs-15), and a community user confirms the hooks work well for pushing progress updates to the UI during long OpenAI calls (comm-4). Missing for 10: detailed first-party evidence of the frontend hook/auth mechanics and step-level metadata updates, and recent independent hands-on corroboration of token streaming specifically.
